cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — perched on a ledge or edge; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — perched on a ledge or edge; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small independent riverside cinema lobby with old film reels and an unlettered ticket stand — she dresses as a retro cinema usher for a themed evening; a modern canal-side bakery terrace at blue hour — she pauses to break a warm pull-apart bun into two portions; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — chest-deep in the water; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — holds a cup in both hands; her crew cabin aboard a starship — turns a page of a book lying open on the table; a shopping mall atrium with a fountain and glass railings — standing; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a misty enchanted garden of moss — holds her keepsake at chest height
